entries.text: Compare configurations using both latency and accuracy. Read each row together with its headers and units. Lower latency means less waiting, while higher accuracy means a larger percentage of correct results.

essential_visual_facts: Rows A/B/C have latency 12/9/15 ms and accuracy 88/92/90 percent.
B is lowest latency and highest accuracy.
Headers and row associations must stay intact.
